name: The drowned hound
locks: Horse-sized, gaunt and heavy-boned quadrupedal hound; long body, prominent ribs/hips, heavy shoulders, long weight-bearing legs and long jaw.
Waterlogged black fur hangs in wet clumps; water streams from muzzle, belly and coat.
River weed and barnacles attach to flanks and outer shoulders.
Crooked yellow canine teeth; pale clouded dull eyes, never luminous eyes.
Only one small black-violet Hush crack on the brow leaking violet ash; intact animal face, never a humanoid face-hole.
Fast in water and clumsy on dry ground.
Anatomically canine paws with four weight-bearing toes and claws; no human hands.
Sheets: flat light grey, upper-left neutral light, no scale person or silhouette, no lettering. Action scene: human scale silhouette retained.
choices_where_design_is_open: Grey-beige hollow barnacle clusters and olive river-weed ribbons; individual clusters are organic, not armour.
style: V2 Cinematic cel; exact style, cleanup, character snippet and negative blocks archived in every tool prompt.
